test_title: PYST 50: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 04 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: The simple interest on a certain sum for 4(5)/(9) years at the rate of 3.6% per annum is Rs. 5,453. What will be the amount payable on the same sum at the rate of 2.7% per annum simple interest in 6(2)/(9) years?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple Interest = ₹5453

Time₁ = 4(5)/(9) years

Rate₁ = 3.6% per annum

Time₂ = 6(2)/(9) years

Rate₂ = 2.7% per annum

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest = (Principal Rate × Time) ÷ 100

Amount = Principal + Simple Interest

**Calculation:**

&am
